value.rationale: Natural complete **graph-isomorphism** classification for all finite-chain-ring Heisenberg full commuting graphs and inverse recovery of \(q,m\) by degree strata. A single commutation-preserving bijection is substantively stronger than an earlier all-arity count (which already established the nonisoclinic ring pair). The theorem gives an explicit common nested-projective geometry across all ring isomorphism types, rather than recomputing numerical moments or a small finite census.
